title: excoecaria densiflora
intro: Excoecaria densiflora, commonly known as the poison tree, is a plant species in the family Euphorbiaceae. It is traditionally used in various cultures for its medicinal properties, which include providing health benefits such as antioxidant and anti-inflammatory activities. The plant is reported to have therapeutic actions such as pain relief, fever reduction, and antiseptic properties, attributed to its ability to modulate various biological pathways. The bioactive constituents of Excoecaria densiflora include alkaloids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
